note: Guides are original writing for this entry, based on the official descriptions and the sources cited beside each trophy. Two trophies (Bad Luck, I Guess; Ten Pin) were unconfirmed at launch and are marked so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is no separate trick to it. Play the five-chapter story, work through the roadmap stages for side strands, activities and collectibles, and finish the 100% Completion checklist — the platinum follows on its own.
steps: Finish the story across its five chapters.
Clear the side strands, activities and collectible trophies in the roadmap stages.
Attain 100% Completion for "A Long Road"; this platinum unlocks right after.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1 and it unlocks as soon as the mission wraps up — you cannot miss it.
steps: Start Chapter 1 and follow the opening mission markers.
Finish the Gone Fishing mission objectives.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Keep playing the Chapter 1 main missions in order and it pops when the chapter ends and Chapter 2 begins.
steps: Play through the Chapter 1 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission to move into Chapter 2.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Work through the Chapter 2 main missions and it unlocks when the chapter closes and Chapter 3 starts.
steps: Play through the Chapter 2 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission to move into Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Play the Chapter 3 main missions to the end and it pops as the story moves into Chapter 4.
steps: Play through the Chapter 3 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission to move into Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Finish the Chapter 4 main missions and it unlocks when the chapter ends and the story moves on to its final stretch.
steps: Play through the Chapter 4 main missions.
Finish the chapter's final mission.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy and the gold reward for seeing the story through. Play the main missions all the way to the end and it pops when the final mission is done.
steps: Play through all five chapters of the story.
Complete the final mission.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and it unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in Chapter 2.
Complete all of its objectives.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist and it unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist mission in Chapter 3.
Complete all of its objectives.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play and it unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in Chapter 4.
Complete all of its objectives.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners and it unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in Chapter 4.
Complete all of its objectives.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown and it unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in Chapter 4.
Complete all of its objectives.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: An automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory and it unlocks when the mission ends.
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in Chapter 5.
Complete all of its objectives.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the game and the gold that gates the platinum. The 100% checklist only opens after the story, under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but progress you make during the story already counts. The requirements are forgiving: it works out to roughly 60% true completion, with most side quests not required and collectibles only partly required. Nothing on the checklist is missable, so it can all be done in free-roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the 100% checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Complete any 100 optional missions, scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, and study any 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars.
Finish 300 stunts, all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests, plus any 70 of the 80 challenges.
Check the list after the story and clear whatever is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings, and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick whichever you find quickest; flying under bridges is generally the fastest. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the platinum.
steps: Open the map and filter for stunt spots to find ones near you.
Complete any 250 stunts across the four categories.
Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The trophy tracker counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or drone race, and performing a stunt. Try each one once. You will be introduced to most of them through the story, and the rest show up as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map. In practice this pops on its own while you work on the other trophies.
steps: Check Progress > Activities (Touchpad > Progress > Activities) to see which types you have done.
Try each missing type once — the map's Activities filter shows where they are.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges spread across the 12 shooting ranges. The gold scores are not too demanding, and the ranges are also needed for the 100% checklist, so this is a natural stop on the way to the platinum.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges around Leonida.
Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 challenges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — there are 42 drone races in total, but one win per location is enough. The drone races are also required for the 100% checklist, so they are worth clearing as you go.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race spots around Leonida (14 locations).
Win at least one race at every location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so you have twice as many to choose from as you need — pick the short, easy ones first and come back for the rest only if you want to. Each race only has to be won once.
steps: Find race locations on the map (40 unique spots).
Win 20 different races.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Some time after the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline from there and beat him in the fishing challenge to unlock this.
steps: Play past the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text, then head to the marked fishing spot.
Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: There are four arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — you can start as early as Chapter 1 — while Bang For Your Buck is found at arcade machines around the world. To complete a game, finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge, and any of the four games counts.
steps: Pick any of the four arcade games.
Play through all of its levels to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 3 and is exclusive to Lucia. While playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address that marks the questline in Belville. Complete her five quests and the trophy pops after the last one. The whole line stays available after the story.
steps: In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow the marker to Belville.
Complete Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's optional questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1. A while after the mission Island Dreams, where you work for Kenton, he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — purple treasure chest icons on the map — and you dig the treasure up from the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring it back to him. In total he wants seven shipwrecks cleared. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2-3, so nothing here is missable.
steps: After Island Dreams in Chapter 1, take Kenton's call and visit him in Key Lento.
Dive the marked shipwrecks, dig up the treasure with the metal detector, and return it to Kenton.
Keep returning when he calls with more locations until all seven shipwrecks are cleared.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete his five quests and the trophy pops after the last one. All of them stay available after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Note that not every optional questline counts: the questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. The strands confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more strangers still being found. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story, and the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many you have finished.
steps: Find Strangers & Freaks questlines in the open world.
Complete the strands for Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Finish eight counting strands in total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered. He marks some of them for you in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street — scan a high-end sports car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage, marked with a green RK icon in the west of Vice City. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List.
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's list.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to find ones Randy wants.
Deliver all 16 cars to Randy's garage.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's optional questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is only available as Jason. Purple markers point you to Synthetic Labs in Vice City — go there and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, and finishing it unlocks the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
steps: After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, play as Jason and follow the purple lab markers.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs in Take Out Kitty Litter.
Complete Tyrone's follow-up quest Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as two meditations at the same location, and you cannot finish the last one until you can play both characters together (after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break). Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING: the first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is the only possibly missable trophy in the game. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you must follow her and choose Accept. It is still unclear whether that Chapter 1 meditation is required for the trophy, so do it anyway and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept.
Meditate at all 18 spots, with both Jason and Lucia at each one.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's optional questline is marked automatically at some point after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. Playing as Jason, you get a text from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Lucia cannot receive the message). Meet him, then follow his hunting requests: he marks hunting spots with purple icons, you hunt the animals he asks for and bring them to him as Jason. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can retrieve from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. It is still being confirmed exactly which animal unlocks this trophy, but working through Bret's quests — all 15 Target Decks are also needed for the 100% checklist — is the way to get it.
steps: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, play as Jason and wait for Bret's text.
Meet Bret in Lummox County for Veteran Hunted.
Hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find collectible cards around Leonida and complete three full card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so you only need a fraction of what exists — pick up cards as you explore and the sets will come together naturally.
steps: Collect cards from the card set locations around Leonida.
Complete any three full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app on your phone to scan 100 locations. Hold Up and then R1 to scan whatever you are looking at. There are far more than 100 scannable spots — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags — so any 100 will do; just scan as you travel and this pops quickly.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up on your phone).
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and tags with Up + R1.
Scan any 100 locations in total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You can view and track them under Progress, then Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right shows which ones you have finished. Most of them complete naturally while you work on the other trophies, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy unlocks on the way. Save it for late, then pick the easiest remaining challenges to finish it off.
steps: Work on other trophies — most challenges complete passively.
Check Progress > Challenges for what is left.
Finish any 50 challenges in total.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with Jason and Lucia together. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then build up a 4-star wanted level by causing carnage. The trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone — not just the flashing search area. A fast sports motorcycle helps you cut through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because the helicopter cannot see you on the tracks. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since the big bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Reach a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape the red heat zone — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia works well.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: You can only do this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle, then rob three shops in a row while the police are chasing you the whole time — you need to keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted level going, not lose it. Bring an armored vest and sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a few items in each store and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The unlock is delayed — it pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — and if it does not pop, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Rob three shops in a row without losing your wanted level.
Wait about half a minute after the third shop; if it does not pop, rob a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. Open the WAiNK app from your phone (hold Up to use it instantly) and scan vehicles by looking at them and holding R1. You do not need to drive them; scanning is enough. The easiest method is to stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. The 100% checklist needs 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so this trophy comes automatically on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app by holding Up.
Scan vehicles by looking at them and holding R1.
Discover any 100 vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar in the top-left of the screen. You must take down five enemies in a single use, and the effect only lasts a few seconds, so set it up first. Buff your focus by eating, drinking, or washing your face and showering at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle) to stretch the effect. Line up five enemies — the criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them fast without missing, using an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556 assault rifle and body armor from an Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. It reportedly does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels, raised by shooting range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier as you progress and may well pop naturally.
steps: Raise your focus level and stock up on Adrenaline and body armor.
Find a group of five or more gang criminals and line them up.
Activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and take down five enemies in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head straight to the plane, and climb the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads directly into the plane. Inside, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the trophy pops a little late, once you are far enough away.
steps: Go to VCIA and drive through a fence onto the airfield.
Board the large plane docked at departure terminal E3/E4 via the stairs by the boarding bridge.
Reverse to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. They are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate — or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance — climb into a tank, and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Enter the base and reach the tanks in the south.
Get into a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies — the stores are marked automatically with a green icon in unfogged map areas. Break into a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory permanently; approaching a locked door gives you the choice between kicking it, which triggers the alarm, and the silent Snap Gun approach). In the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good location to try it.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies.
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage, disable the alarm, and leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies. In it you tail a security van until it stops at a bank, a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside, and the vault opens — slip in quickly and rob it. You cannot carry all the cash alone, so bring your partner and hold Right to hand off a bag. After that quest you can pay Yasmani — the fence unlocked in Chapter 3 — for tips about security vans: finish his earlier quests first (robbing two Payday Loans), then he sells van tips for $10,000, marking the vans with a purple icon. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are eight large bank jobs in total and you only need five for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all eight. A single bank can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vault robberies.
Buy security van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each.
Tail a van to a bank, rob the vault with your partner, escape, and repeat for five vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), the same mission that opens up bank vault robberies: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Since the 100% checklist needs all eight large bank jobs, you will get this trophy on the way. You can also get it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open. Either way, the trophy only pops once you have escaped the red heat radius, so get clear or use a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs can be found in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence automatically from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, or find an armored truck near a bank in Vice City.
Rob the truck — sticky bomb its back door if you are doing it free-roam.
Escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is visible. It pairs well with the stunts and vehicle scanning you are doing anyway.
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged part of the map until all 52 areas are revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are nine gangs and 39 illegal gang operations in total. For this trophy you only need to rob one operation belonging to each gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so it unlocks automatically on the way. The operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track them under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
steps: Find illegal gang operations (yellow icons) around Leonida.
Rob one operation for each of the nine gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops as you enjoy the cocktail with the view.
steps: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it by the bar.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it out through the window: the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Hack into the car, drive forward and straight through the showroom window. The unlock is slightly delayed and pops once you have driven further away on the street. It only works with this blue Banshee — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III — not with any other car.
steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Chapter 3).
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window and keep driving down the street.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Before you go, buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to blow open the safe. You visit the alley during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway by blowing it up with sticky bombs. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not the moment you grab the third item, and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you do not get all three items during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a long while — you can go back and steal the remaining valuables, so the trophy is not missable and you do not need all three in one visit.
steps: Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation.
During Hit Kingpin Bowling (Chapter 2) or on a later visit, enter Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Steal the luxury watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start this after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check your strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, selecting a character and scrolling to Strength (the heart icon). Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club, of which there are many across Vice City (filter for them on the map under Activities, the dumbbell icon), or work out at home after the story. Always bring your partner along (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle) so you train together.
Work out at fitness clubs until both characters reach maximum strength.
Check Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength to confirm both are maxed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and it helps to turn on criminal profile notifications in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, setting Criminal Profile to On — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever something you do affects your reputation. The profile ranges from Professional (stealthy objectives and clean escapes) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and Irredeemable is a permanent status if you keep using excessive violence. This happens passively while you work on the other trophies, since every robbery and enemy encounter counts — do not worry about it until the end, and if anything is left, it can be farmed quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car, though at Psycho or Irredeemable the police are more likely to shoot on sight.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters count toward the 500.
If anything remains at the end, keep doing profile-affecting actions until the counter hits 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch — no verified method exists yet for this trophy, so this guide does not invent one. The official description, "Second time's the charm", suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, and the current best guess in the community is that it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — but that is unconfirmed speculation, not a method. Wait for a verified method to be published and check the sources below before trying anything specific.
steps: No verified steps exist yet — do not follow rumored methods as if they were confirmed.
Check the cited sources for updates once a method is verified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and come solo — it is slightly random and not a guaranteed spawn. Sometimes you will find a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back later. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside as she asks, and the trophy unlocks.
steps: Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return later.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, talk to the abducted woman, offer to help, and return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed at launch — no verified method exists yet for this trophy, so this guide does not invent one. The official description, "Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by", suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle, and the current best guess in the community is that it comes from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — but that is unconfirmed speculation, not a method. Wait for a verified method to be published and check the sources below before trying anything specific.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all your robberies, so you do not need to deliver it in one go, and it comes naturally while you do the robberies for the 100% checklist. Bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they are only unlocked after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is.
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver a total of $250,000 in marked bills to a fence.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — the total is cumulative, so normal shopping counts. The fastest way is to buy the expensive stuff: guns at the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods at the 14 mod shops, and tattoos. Clothing stores, footwear stores, hair and beauty salons, electronics stores and Pay 'n' Sprays all count too.
steps: Spend money across any shops — the total is cumulative.
Buy guns, car mods and tattoos first; they are the most expensive items.
Keep shopping until you have spent $100,000 in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages — the four story-related garages do not count. They cost $160,000 in total and become available for purchase after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, has been installed on your phone. Buy them all through that app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones unlocked in Chapters 3 and 4.
steps: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Open the app on your phone and buy each of the eight garages.
Earn the $160,000 total through robberies if you are short.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. To register ten vehicles you first need enough garages, since each garage adds one or more parking spots — so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and then Register. You unlock Moses from the same mission that unlocks the app. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later, in Chapter 3, you can also register cars with standard trackers, and register them at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the expense down.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy enough garages for parking spots.
Drive ten stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register (or use a Pay 'n' Spray from Chapter 3).
